description: Screen a name (person, company, vessel, aircraft) against all loaded sanctions watchlists at once — OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU, UK, and UN — alias- and fuzzy-aware. Returns scored potential matches with the source list, sanctioning program, designation date, and the matched alias; an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish under one entry ID is one hit, its sources naming both lists. Strict mode (default) matches exact-normalized then all-tokens-present, then runs a fuzzy pass over each selected list strict finds nothing on: a full pass when strict finds nothing on any list, otherwise one that adds only candidates covering every word of the name other than legal forms, articles and other function words, and the jurisdiction codes uk, usa, uae, and rf, ranked after the strict hits. Fuzzy mode runs the fuzzy pass over every selected list. It adds Jaro-Winkler and phonetic matching and labels hits approximate with a raw 0–1 similarity score plus the count of query tokens the candidate covers, which orders candidates that tie on score; fuzzySources names the lists it searched. Results are paged: totalAvailable and hasMore report matches beyond the returned page, and nextOffset retrieves them. This is a screening AID for a human/compliance review, NOT a compliance determination: a hit means "review this candidate against the official source," and an empty result never means "cleared."

entityType.description: Restrict to one entity class, or "any" (default) to screen across all.

limit.description: Maximum number of potential matches to return in one page.

matchMode.description: strict (default): exact-normalized then all-tokens-present, then a fuzzy pass over each selected list strict finds nothing on — a full pass when strict finds nothing on any list, otherwise adding only candidates that cover every word of the name other than legal forms, articles and other function words, and the jurisdiction codes uk, usa, uae, and rf. fuzzy: a scored Jaro-Winkler + phonetic pass over every selected list.

minScore.description: Score floor for approximate hits (0–1), applied uniformly to every fuzzy candidate regardless of how it was matched (Jaro-Winkler, token, or phonetic); a query token counts toward queryTokenCoverage only when its match clears it too. It governs every fuzzy pass: fuzzy mode, and in strict mode the pass over the lists strict found nothing on, so raising it can remove approximate hits from a strict screen as well. Exact and strong hits are unaffected. Defaults to the server's configured floor.

name.description: The name to screen (person, organization, vessel, or aircraft), in any script. It must contain at least one letter or digit, and at most 64 words and 1024 characters.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first potential match to return. Re-call with the returned nextOffset to page through every match when hasMore is true; an offset past the end returns an empty page, not an error.

sources.description: Restrict to specific source lists. Omit to screen all loaded lists.

name: sanctions_screen_name

caveat.description: Decision-support caveat — this is a screening aid, not a compliance determination.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `name_not_searchable`: The name contains no letter or digit, so nothing in it can be matched. `name_too_long`: The name is longer than 64 words or 1024 characters. `mirror_not_ready`: The sanctions mirror has never completed an initial sync. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fuzzySources.description: The selected lists the fuzzy pass searched, in list order; absent when no fuzzy pass ran. Beside strict hits these are the lists strict found nothing on, and only their candidates covering every word of the name other than legal forms, articles and other function words, and the jurisdiction codes uk, usa, uae, and rf were added.

hasMore.description: True when the result set holds matches beyond this page — re-call with nextOffset. It describes pages only: false on the last page, whatever totalAvailableBasis says.

hits.description: Potential matches, ranked by match type, then score, then how much of the query each candidate explains. Candidates tied on all three are ordered by source list, then entry ID — not by relevance.

items.description: One potential match — a candidate to verify, never a determination.

designationDate.description: The source's own designation date as YYYY-MM-DD; absent when unpublished. For an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish, the date of the source record: each OFAC file dates the party from its own lists, so the two often differ, and sanctions_get_designation under the other list returns that record's date.

entityType.description: Entity classification as published by the source.

matchType.description: exact = normalized name equality; strong = all query tokens present; approximate = fuzzy/phonetic.

matchedName.description: The specific name or alias string that matched the query.

matchedNameType.description: Provenance of the matched name: primary, a.k.a., f.k.a., or a low-quality a.k.a.

primaryName.description: Primary published name of the designated entity.

program.description: Sanctioning program / regime, when published by the source.

queryTokenCoverage.description: How much of the query this candidate explains, as a literal token count — a second real measurement, never folded into score. It is the tie-break applied after score, because one shared exact token pins several candidates at the same score. Absent for exact/strong hits.

covered.description: Query tokens individually matched by one of this candidate's tokens at the applied score floor.

total.description: Total tokens in the normalized query.

referenceNumber.description: The list's published reference number (UN, EU, UK OFSI Group ID); absent when the list publishes none for the entry.

score.description: Raw Jaro-Winkler similarity (0–1) for approximate hits only — a real measurement, not a confidence verdict. Absent for exact/strong hits.

source.description: The watchlist whose record this hit's fields come from — its provenance. For an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish, ofac_sdn unless the Consolidated record matched alone or better; sources names every list.

sourceEntryId.description: The list's own entry ID — pass to sanctions_get_designation for the full record.

sourceLabel.description: Human-readable name of the source list.

sources.description: Every screened list this candidate is on, in list order: one list, or ofac_sdn and ofac_consolidated together for an OFAC party both OFAC lists publish under one entry ID — one hit, not two. Read this, not source, for every list; the entry ID resolves in sanctions_get_designation under each.

matchModeUsed.description: fuzzy when every selected list was fuzzy-searched (fuzzy mode, or a strict screen that found nothing on any list); strict otherwise, including a strict screen whose strict-empty lists were completed by a fuzzy pass.

nextOffset.description: The offset to request next. Present only when hasMore is true.

normalizedQuery.description: The name as the server folded it for matching.

notice.description: Guidance when no candidate matched — how to broaden, and what an empty result does NOT mean — when the requested offset sits past the end of the result set, or when the fuzzy pass reached its candidate bound and a more distinctive word would narrow it.

totalAvailable.description: Potential matches in the result set across all pages, before limit and offset were applied — every one is reachable by paging. An OFAC party both OFAC lists publish counts once.

totalAvailableBasis.description: How to read totalAvailable: exact = the complete strict match set, strict having found a match on every selected list; lower_bound = a fuzzy pass ran (fuzzySources is present), which scores only the candidates blocking pooled, so more matches may exist beyond the result set.

totalCount.description: Number of potential matches returned in this page.

title: sanctions-screening-mcp-server: screen name
